title: Operand evaluation after extending a straight-line program
statement: Let $x:	ext{Fin}(n)	o	ext{Bool}$ be an assignment, let $ss$ and $ext$ be lists of straight-line statements, and let $o$ be an operand whose referenced line indices are all less than the length of $ss$. Then the value of $o$ after running the program formed by appending $ext$ to $ss$ is the same as its value after running $ss$.
hypotheses_covered: An operand $o$ whose referenced line indices are less than $|ss|$
